title: This Lizard Squirts Blood From Its Eyes, and Dogs Hate It
subject: horned lizard

scenes.text: A lizard shoots blood from its eyes. Coyotes back off.
It can squirt up to five feet. The jet goes straight at the attacker.
The lizard raises pressure in blood sinuses near its eyes until they burst open.
It works best on dogs and coyotes. Against other predators, it flattens and hides.
Scientists think the blood tastes foul, maybe from the ants the lizard eats.
A spiny lizard that fights with its own blood.

description:
The horned lizard can squirt blood from its eyes up to five feet at coyotes and other dogs.
The jet comes from pressure building in blood sinuses.
Would you go near it?
first_comment: Why do you think it only does this to dogs? Tell us your guess.
